criteria.requirement: Create `core`, an IcosahedronGeometry(1,1) mesh at the origin, and `group`, containing exactly 125 BoxGeometry(0.1,0.1,0.1) meshes.
criteria.action: Load the page and inspect the live scene, core geometry, group children, initial names, positions, and rotations.
criteria.expected: The core has the specified geometry and origin transform; 125 cubes appear in x/y/z iteration order at the exact lattice coordinates with the specified rotations. (Tolerance: 1e-5 for transforms; exact counts, geometry parameters, and names)

criteria.requirement: Accept only if its distance from the origin is at least 2 and its distance from every already accepted target is at least 0.35.
criteria.action: Call scatter(12345), then step(2), and inspect every target and final live cube position.
criteria.expected: All 125 targets are componentwise within [-2.5,2.5], every origin distance is at least 2, every pairwise distance is at least 0.35, and final positions equal targets. (Tolerance: 1e-5, allowing floating-point boundary comparisons)

criteria.requirement: Set the PRNG state to `seed >>> 0`; for every draw update it with `state = (1664525 * state + 1013904223) >>> 0` and return `state / 4294967296`.
criteria.action: Reset, scatter with seed 987654321 and save targets; reset and repeat the same seed, then compare against an independent implementation of the stated LCG and acceptance order.
criteria.expected: Both runs and the independent calculation produce identical targets in group-child order. (Tolerance: Exact PRNG sequence; positions within 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: Cube i has delay `0.05*(i%5)`. During `step(dt)`, local time is `clamp(elapsed-delay,0,1)`, interpolation weight is `q=t*t*(3-2*t)`, and position is `start+(target-start)*q`.
criteria.action: After a fresh scatter, call step(0.5) and inspect cubes 0 and 1 and the core rotation.
criteria.expected: Cube 0 uses t=0.5 and q=0.5; cube 1 uses t=0.45 and q=0.42525; both match start+(target-start)*q, and core rotation is (0.1,0.15,0). (Tolerance: 1e-5 per component)

criteria.requirement: Ignore negative, NaN, or infinite dt; otherwise add dt to elapsed.
criteria.action: Capture state, call step with -1, NaN, and Infinity, then call step(0.25).
criteria.expected: Invalid calls change neither elapsed nor any transform; the valid call advances elapsed by exactly 0.25 and applies the corresponding animation. (Tolerance: 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: `reset()` restores the exact initial lattice positions and rotations, core rotation (0,0,0), seed 0, elapsed 0, and scattering false; clear each cube’s scatter start and target to null.
criteria.action: Move the camera, complete a scatter, invoke reset, and inspect scene objects, API state, and camera.
criteria.expected: All lattice and core state returns to its initial values without object recreation; scatter vectors are null and the moved camera and controls remain unchanged. (Tolerance: 1e-5; object identities and camera state exact)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
